Two in the morning. Thirty-four weeks pregnant, and bleeding.
Her family has one question, and every wrong answer costs time.
She taps what's happening, where it is, and what she sees. That's all it takes.
VITALIS only offers hospitals that can treat her, and they're alerted at once.
The hospital accepts on its own screen, and her phone tells her to go now.
A chemist on the corner can start the same journey.
Her ID carries her name and NHIA number everywhere.
At the bedside, the AI finds an allergy written at another hospital, and blocks the clash.
But the doctor stays in charge.
Lab and radiology each work their own list.
Nobody sees her history unless she allows it, and she can see who looked.
VITALIS. Get the right hospital, fast.
